turns.customer: Boarding my cat Luna Jan 12-15 2027. She has her rabies shot. Is that all she needs?
blocks:
Rabies alone **isn’t enough** according to Happy Tails Pet Resort’s posted requirements for cats: Luna also needs the **feline distemper combination vaccine**, covering feline distemper, rhinotracheitis, and calicivirus. They require written proof from your veterinarian before boarding. The resort recommends giving vaccines two weeks before boarding, so check that Luna’s records are current for **January 12, 2027**. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/vaccination-requirements-policies))

This is an unofficial planning demo, so I can’t confirm whether Luna’s records meet the requirement or check availability for those dates.
